prior_importants.description: Moving merge-gate.constants.ts into src/core/constants/ takes it out of CRITICAL_AREAS: a task scoped to it now routes as standard instead of critical, and `pup land --remeasure` lands commits past the pin that edit it (PROTECTED_PATH_GLOBS included) without asking for --approved-by.

findings.description: The new CRITICAL_AREAS JSDoc says extracted types/constants/errors are "named beside" their area, but the `*.repository.ts` and `db.client.ts` areas are covered by entries named after concepts (session, ledger, baseline-history, decision-record), and the sentence does not say a future extraction out of a critical file needs its own entry here.

ADR 0092 still enumerates the 12 original critical-area globs, while this PR grows CRITICAL_AREAS to about 30 entries; a reader taking the ADR as the full list misses the extracted types/constants/errors paths.

process_issues.description: The incremental delta is 2 files and 42 lines (CRITICAL_AREAS entries plus a test), so every area ran as one instance. simplicity, context, maintainability, workflow-safety and spec were not spawned: the delta adds no helper, wrapper, option or branch; it touches no infra or workflow surface; maintainability is off the default roster; and no spec source exists.
